prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Primary request: Design an original high-fidelity UI mockup for MiXianTu, a Minecraft xianxia cultivation mod. A single complete in-game GUI panel, front-on orthographic 2D, large and centered with a small dark desaturated Minecraft-world backdrop margin. This is art direction inspiration for an implementable game interface, not a website and not a physical photographed book. Keep the UI practical, compact, legible and generous in blank space. Render blocky Minecraft item sprites and a blocky Minecraft player; preserve clean grid alignment and sharp nearest-neighbor pixel edges. Combine restrained Chinese historical material motifs with Minecraft pixel geometry. All decorative elements must stay away from item cells and text. Small square corners, thin inset double borders, consistent frame geometry, no modern pill buttons, no decorative blur over text, no rainbow neon, no random HUDs, no watermark, no brand logos, no additional panels outside the main GUI. Use only the specified short Chinese labels, carefully typeset and readable; do not invent paragraphs or placeholder gibberish. Illustrative example values are allowed as listed. Create polished new design ideas rather than copying an existing screenshot. The whole interface must be completely visible, not cropped. The output is a single design, not a collage.
Layout invariants: Panel proportions approximately 510:315, a landscape character status sheet. Two modest plaque tabs at top, labels "人物信息" and "习得功法", first selected. Four small armor equipment frames stacked vertically at upper left, containing faint helmet/chestplate/leggings/boots silhouettes. Immediately to their right, a rectangular full-body preview of a Minecraft player in a plain teal robe; a faint circular seal behind the player is allowed. Under this left section, a compact "基本信息" area with readable label/value rows such as "生命 20 / 20", "护甲 6", "速度 0.10". Right section is wider, headed "修炼", neatly aligned labels and values: "境界 炼气", "灵力 80.00 / 100.00", "寿元 86 / 120", "灵根 火灵根", "体质 普通". A slender framed resource bar under the relevant number. Below, "所习功法" with three separate rows "养气诀", "御剑诀", "炼体诀", each with a tiny restrained jade-slip marker. A slim subtle scroll indicator on the right edge of the content area. Keep labels dark and readable, values aligned, no progress arcs replacing text and no extra invented mechanics.
Art direction: Warm xuanzhi paper #f6f1e4, dark ink #3a322a, cinnabar accents #9c2c2c, quiet dark-jade secondary details #436650, muted old-gold micro accents. A strong but clean scholar's dossier / bound manual direction. Off-white paper with barely visible fibres, warm wooden outer rail with thin dark-brown inset lines, restrained cloud-scroll corner motifs, a tiny red seal at an unused corner, flat bamboo or wood plaque tabs. Small hand-painted cloud/ridge ink wash only at spare corners at very low opacity. Subtle layered paper margins and small binding-stitch details at the outside frame. NO horizontal notebook ruling behind data. Keep this the most plausible direct evolution of a parchment AUI theme; restrained, useful and crisp.

The qi seal is a subtle visual focal point in the small gap between crafting grid and output, suggesting a slow soft pulse without making anything blurry.
